siteView.tooltipProviders: the Tooltip.Provider ancestors are kept where the example's files reach the tooltip (each result's tooltipProviders); see omitted

omitted.what: the ancestors' other children: SiteHeader, SiteFooter, DocsSidebar, the table of contents, the page's title, description, links and other markdown
omitted.why: they are not the example; DocsSidebar and the table of contents are hidden below the lg and xl breakpoints (the census viewport is 800 px wide)

omitted.what: ComponentPreview's code panel (the hosts pass hideCode)
omitted.why: it holds the example's highlighted source (mdsx and shiki at the site's build), not the example
it renders in dev only ($app/environment); the site is a production build

omitted.what: app.html's head: the user config cookie script and the analytics scripts
omitted.why: the cookie script does nothing without the scn_user_config cookie, which the census does not set; the analytics scripts are remote and draw nothing

omitted.what: the (app) layout's ModeWatcher (mode-watcher, defaultMode system) and its `d` key handler
omitted.why: mode-watcher does not lower (E_DEPENDENCY: it does not declare sideEffects false; example census); in Chromium's default light scheme it sets color-scheme: light on <html>, the default rendering
svelte-sonner does not lower (E_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED in dist/toast-state.svelte.js; example census); without a toast it renders an empty notification section

omitted.what: the two Tooltip.Provider ancestors (the (app) and (layout) layouts'), for an example none of whose files reaches the tooltip (registry/ui/tooltip or bits-ui's Tooltip; the host's tooltipProviders is false)
omitted.why: a Tooltip.Provider renders only its children and sets a context only bits-ui's tooltip reads (it also listens for window scrolls that close an open tooltip); in a program without a tooltip its state does not lower (E_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED at bits-ui/dist/bits/tooltip/tooltip.svelte.js:16: the trigger registry's untyped `new Map()`, whose entries only the tooltip's own code sets), while an example that reaches the tooltip keeps both providers

omitted.what: the docs layout's Sidebar.Provider (registry/ui/sidebar): its wrapper <div data-slot="sidebar-wrapper">, a full-width flex row whose one rendered child is the full-width "h-full w-full" div, its Tooltip.Provider (delayDuration 0) and its keyboard shortcut
omitted.why: it does not lower (E_CAPABILITY: svelte/reactivity's MediaQuery, through registry/hooks/is-mobile.svelte.ts); the wrapper draws no background or border and its child keeps its place, the tooltip provider acts on hover only, and the census presses no key
a MutationObserver that removes cn-menu-translucent from menus as they open; the census opens none
